app_fee.value: The Graduate School application processing fee is $70 for international applicants and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: The Pinkie Gordon Lane Graduate School application processing fee for domestic and permanent resident applicants is $50 and $70 for international applicants

also.quote: Complete the online application for admission and pay the $50 non-refundable application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School fee waivers are limited and open to eligible domestic applicants; international students do not qualify.
fee_waiver.quote: LSU offers a limited number of fee waiver options on a first-come, first-serve basis to eligible domestic applicants. International students do not qualify for Graduate School application fee waivers

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not require GRE or other standardized tests; departments set their own rules.
gre_general.quote: The Pinkie Gordon Lane Graduate School does not require the submission of standardized admission test scores

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 (internet-based) for graduate admission.
toefl_min.quote: The following minimum scores are required for admission: 79 (internet-based exam)

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum of 6.5 for graduate admission.
ielts_min.quote: The following minimum score is required for admission: 6.5
